action.Description: Creatures with this role gain a +5-status bonus to speed.
action.Label: Action

Addendum.Invisible: If you're invisible, you become concealed instead.

chiaroscuro.Description: If the creature with this role was invisible, it becomes concealed instead. If the creature was already concealed for any other reason, it is no longer concealed.
chiaroscuro.Label: Chiaroscuro

comedy.Description: Creatures with this role take a –1 status penalty to Reflex saves.
comedy.Label: Comedy

costume.Description: Creatures with this role gain resistance equal to 2 + your Charisma modifier to any one physical or energy damage type you specify when you used Cast a Role to assign the costume role. This increases to 4 + your Charisma modifier if you are expert in Performance, 6 + your Charisma modifier if you are master in Performance, and 8 + your Charisma modifier if you are Legendary in Performance.
costume.Label: Costume

diva.Description: You can Perform once per turn to restore @Damage[(@item.level)[healing]|traits:healing] Hit Points to a creature in a spotlight. This has the healing trait and a trait associated with the performance, usually auditory for singing and move for dancing
diva.Label: Diva

drama.Description: Creatures with this role take a –1 status penalty to Will saves.
drama.Label: Drama

epic.Description: Creatures with this role who critically hit with the first Strike they make each round cause their target to become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.
epic.Label: Epic
epic.Note: If this is your first critical hit with a Strike this round, your target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TkIyaNPgTZFBCCuh]{Dazzled} for 1 round.

horror.Description: Creatures with this role who critically hit with the first Strike they make each round causes their target to become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.
horror.Label: Horror
horror.Note: If this is your first critical hit with a Strike this round, your target becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1}.

irony.Description: Creatures with this role takes a –2 status penalty to their highest unmodified saving throw and gain a +2 status bonus to their lowest unmodified saving throw.
irony.Label: Irony

Prompt.Highest: Select your highest unmodified saving throw.
Prompt.Lowest: Select your lowest unmodified saving throw.

leadActor.Description: You gain a +1 status bonus to checks made for actions with the linguistic trait. You can Perform with the linguistic trait to pull a target into a scene for 2 rounds; All creatures pulled into the same scene are @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} to each other.
leadActor.Label: Lead Actor

pressure.Description: Creatures with this role, are off-guard to the first attack made against them each round. If the creature in the spotlight with this role rolls a critical success, they become immune to the effects of this role for 24 hours.
pressure.Label: Pressure

romance.Description: Creatures take a –1 status penalty to attack and damage rolls against creatures with this role.
romance.Label: Romance

silent.Description: Creatures with this role make no sound, preventing other creatures from noticing it using hearing alone. The creature gains resistance to sonic damage equal to 6 + your Charisma modifier, and gains a +2 status bonus to saving throw against effects with the auditory or sonic traits. If the target uses an auditory action, including speaking as a free action, they become immune to this role for 1 round.
silent.Label: Silent

stagehand.Description: Creatures with this role are invisible. If the creature uses a move action or takes damage, shimmers and ripples in the role make them hidden instead of undetected until the start of their next turn. If the creature uses a hostile action, the creature becomes immune to this role for 24 hours after that hostile action is completed.
stagehand.Label: Stagehand

Note.Damage: If you take damage, shimmers and ripples in the role make you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} instead of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} until the start of your next turn. If you use a hostile action, you become immune to this role for 24 hours after that hostile action is completed.
Note.Move: If you use a move action, shimmers and ripples in the role make you @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.iU0fEDdBp3rXpTMC]{Hidden} instead of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.VRSef5y1LmL2Hkjf]{Undetected} until the start of your next turn. If you use a hostile action, you become immune to this role for 24 hours after that hostile action is completed.

starContestant.Description: The star contestant can turn their bad luck into a thrilling turnabout. When the star contestant fails a check, it gains a +1 status bonus the next time it attempts the check.
starContestant.Label: Star Contestant
starContestant.Note:
When the you fail a check, you gain a +1 status bonus the next time you attempt the check.

@UUID[Compendium.starfinder-field-test-for-pf2e.sf2e-conditions.Item.gaYFZ3CVdg2gMp1r]{Effect: Star Contestant Bonus}
starContestant.ToggleLabel: Star Contestant — Attempting failed check again

starPlayer.Description: You gain 3 temporary Hit Points for the duration of the spell. The first time each round you target a creature with a Strike, the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude] save against the origin's Spell DC or is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.
starPlayer.Label: Star Player
starPlayer.Note: The first time each round you target a creature with a Strike, the creature must succeed at a @Check[fortitude] save against the origin's Spell DC or is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}.

tragedy.Description: Creatures with this role take a –1 status penalty to Fortitude saves.
tragedy.Label: Tragedy

trendsetter.Description: You can Perform to strike a pose and force a creature within 30 feet to attempt a @Check[reflex] save against the origin's spell DC. On a failure, the creature becomes @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 1} for 2 rounds (@UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.i3OJZU2nk64Df3xm]{Clumsy 2} on a critical failure), as the target becomes forcefully clad in holographic avant-garde fashion.
trendsetter.Label: Trendsetter

unlucky.Description: When you Cast a Role with this role, verbally goad the creature into using an attack of your choice, such as jaws or laser pistol. Casting a Role this way gives it the auditory and linguistic traits. The first time each round the creature with this role attempts the chosen attack, they roll the attack roll twice and take the lower result. This is a misfortune effect. If the creature in the spotlight with this role hits with the attack, they become immune to the effects of this role for 24 hours.
unlucky.Label: Unlucky

BoomingBootloader.Jailbreak: One creature of your choice within 10 feet of the creature you summoned must succeed at a Will save against your spell DC or become @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 1} (or @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.TBSHQspnbcqxsmjL]{Frightened 2} on a critical failure).

DebugSpell.Jailbreak: Any die you roll for damage that has a result lower than 3 becomes a result of 3 instead.

DeleteRootAccess.Jailbreak: If the construct or tech creature succeeds at its save but doesn't critically succeed, it is your minion for 1 round. If the construct fails its save, it is your minion for 10 minutes. If it critically fails, it is your minion for 24 hours.

GrenadeSpell.Jailbreak: You can install any spell into a grenade. In that case, creatures roll a separate saving throw against your spell DC if it's not a Reflex save. If you apply the effects of this spellshape to a spell with a basic Reflex save, you can use your spell DC instead of your class DC for the grenade.

HardlightIllusion.Jailbreak: If you use Jailbreak Spell to use this spellshape and modify an illusion spell that deals mental damage, that spell deals another appropriate type of damage based on the type of illusion. This damage does not need to be nonlethal, can deactivate regeneration, and otherwise functions like normal damage.

IncognitoSpell.Jailbreak: You can attempt to @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.actionspf2e.Item.2u915NdUyQan6uKF]{Demoralize} one creature using Arcana instead of Intimidation by making the effects of the spell seem effortless on your part.

OvervoltResistor.Jailbreak: You deal damage equal to your level even if the target is immune to acid, cold, electricity, fire, or sonic damage. Only ignore the first listed immunity this way, even if the target has immunities to multiple listed damage types.

SafemodeSpell.Jailbreak: You can choose to make the spell an illusion that deals nonlethal mental damage. If the spell requires a Fortitude or Reflex save, it becomes a Will save. If the spell requires a spell attack roll against AC, you make your spell attack roll against the target's Will DC instead. The spell gains the illusion and mental traits.

ShatterSpell.Jailbreak: You can deal damage to every creature in the area of the spell effect or adjacent to the targeted magic item, or you can deal 1d6 damage × the target's counteract rank instead of 1d4 damage.

SignalBoost.Jailbreak: Increase that spell's range by 60 feet. As is standard for increasing spell ranges, if the spell normally has a range of touch, you extend its range to 60 feet.

SplitTunneling.Jailbreak: If you fail to affect your primary target (whether your attack fails or the target is immune to the spell), your secondary target becomes your primary target, taking full damage and all effects of the spell.
